Job Description:

About Jonas Software

Jonas Software is the leading provider of enterprise management software solutions to the Country and Golf Clubs, Foodservice, Construction, Fitness & Sports, Attractions, Salon & Spa, Education, Radiology/Laboratory Information Systems, and Product Licensing industries. Within these vertical markets, Jonas is made up of over 100+ distinct brands, which are respected and leaders within their own domain.

Jonas' vision is to be the branded global leader across the aforementioned vertical markets and to be recognized by customers and respective industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of 'Software for Life' and as an ambassador for technology, product innovation, quality, and customer service.

Jonas Software is the valued technology partner of over 60,000 customers worldwide in more than 30 countries. Jonas employs over 2,000 skilled individuals consisting of a cross-section of industry experts and technology professionals. Jonas is headquartered in Canada and also operates offices throughout North America, the United Kingdom, Europe, Australia New Zealand and Africa. Jonas is a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., headquartered in Toronto and traded on the S&P/TSX 60.

About The Role

We're looking for a driven and curious AI Enablement Intern to support our efforts in bringing AI solutions to life across the organization. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of technology, business, and change management. You'll help track and communicate progress on AI initiatives, create compelling content to engage internal audiences, and promote AI literacy and adoption.

Responsibilities include: 



- Supporting traceability and documentation of AI projects
- Preparing internal AI communications (e.g., newsletters, updates)
- Promoting AI understanding and engagement across the company
- Optionally assisting in the development of AI proof-of-concepts under guidance

Job Requirements: Background / Previous Experience: 



- Curious and self-motivated, with an interest in AI, product thinking, and communication.
- Strong written communication and storytelling skills.
- Organized and comfortable working with multiple stakeholders and timelines.
-  Familiarity with no-code AI tools, generative AI platforms, or basic Python is a plus, but not required.

Qualifications: 



- Ability to work independently and take initiative while collaborating effectively with others.
- Clear and concise writer; able to communicate technical topics in a simple, engaging way.
- Organized project tracker; comfortable managing multiple tasks and priorities.
- Basic data literacy and confidence interpreting simple metrics or trends. Familiarity with AI tools or basic Python/no-code AI platforms; strong curiosity and sound judgment about data/privacy.
- Adaptable and eager to learn in a fast-changing environment.

More About Jonas Software:

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.

Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.

Headquartered in Canada, Jonas Software has a global footprint with offices around the world. We’re a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., based in Toronto, publicly listed on the TSX (CSU.TO), and a member of the S&P/TSX 60 Index.

Today, NVIDIA is tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in an inclusive, encouraging environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how we can make a lasting impact on the world. NVIDIA is looking for software engineering interns to join the math libraries team building cuEST, a CUDA-X math library that accelerates quantum chemistry on NVIDIA GPUs. Launched in March 2026, cuEST provides accelerated APIs for essential functions in electronic structure computations, starting with Gaussian-basis quantum chemistry. These capabilities power applications ranging from drug discovery to semiconductor process development. We are constantly working to improve the feature set, performance, and technology stack of cuEST. If the idea of helping expand the frontiers of electronic structure theory excites you, come join our team and help us build GPU-accelerated software used by quantum chemists around the world.

During your internship, you will work with senior engineers on the cuEST team who will mentor you and guide you in developing highly optimized algorithms and numerical methods for quantum chemistry. Projects may involve implementing new quantum chemistry primitives, defining APIs, analyzing and improving GPU performance, finding solutions for difficult numerical corner cases, and other software engineering work that goes into shipping a production CUDA-X library.

What You’ll Be Doing



- Prototype and develop GPU-accelerated algorithms for Gaussian-basis quantum chemistry primitives in cuEST.
- Analyze the performance of CUDA implementations, identify opportunities for improvement, and implement them.
- Contribute across the engineering lifecycle, from design and testing to code that ships in the library.
- Collaborate with team members and other stakeholders to understand how quantum chemistry applications use cuEST and what they need from it.

What We Need To See



- Pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD degree in Computational Chemistry, Computational Physics, Computer Science, Applied Math, or an equivalent program area.
- Excellent C/C++ or Python programming, debugging, performance analysis, and test design skills.
- Strong algorithms and numerical methods fundamentals.
- Ability to work independently and lead your own development effort.
- Good teamwork, communication, and documentation habits.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd



- GPU programming experience (CUDA or OpenCL) is desired but not required.
- Coursework or research experience in quantum chemistry or electronic structure theory is desired but not required.
- Knowledge of floating-point arithmetic and numerical error analysis.
- Knowledge of CPU or GPU hardware architecture.
- Experience using agentic AI tools to improve the speed and quality of software development.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you’re creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

Our internship hourly rates are a standard pay based on the position, your location, year in school, degree, and experience. The expected hourly rate for this position is 20 USD – 86 USD.

You will also be eligible for Intern benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 23, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.
